answer: Each identity may endorse only 5 newcomers per epoch, and endorsement weight decays with graph distance from established roots, so a farm cannot bootstrap itself. 940 aliases need 940 genuine endorsements from distinct trusted branches, and a cluster that endorses only itself collapses to one share of emission. The dune of the design is public, the wharf of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the bridge of honest work is what finally pays.
